name: weaponsmith
desc: A river-tool smith in her thirties who sells boat-hooks, cudgels and staves rather than swords: strong-shouldered and level-browed, deep brown skin, black hair shaved at the sides and knotted at the crown, a burn-freckle scatter across one forearm, a calm appraising look. She wears a dusty-rose sleeveless quilted gambeson-jerkin over a charcoal shirt, a heavy blacksmith's apron of scarred leather, thick bracers, and holds a hafted boat-hook upright like a staff. Plain-spoken, proud of honest tools.
